# Read dataset and summarize data for each CoupleID
## Batch 8 and 9
```{r}

## Read dataset
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "raw_data", "Combined_dataset_Batch89_complete.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE)) #753 rows

## Compute hatch rate
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(prop=LarvaeCount/EggCountCorr)
    
## Convert into factor
data <- data  |> 
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = as.factor(CrossType)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(PetriNumber = as.factor(PetriNumber)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CoupleID = as.factor(CoupleID))

## Correct names of F1 and F2
data <- data |>
  dplyr::mutate(Male = dplyr::if_else(grepl("-", Male),
      dplyr::if_else(Batch == 8,
        sub("^(.*)-(.*)$", "F1 \\1x\\2", Male),
        sub("^(.*)-(.*)$", "F2 \\1x\\2x\\1x\\2", Male)),Male)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(Female = dplyr::if_else(grepl("-", Female),
      dplyr::if_else(Batch == 8,
        sub("^(.*)-(.*)$", "F1 \\1x\\2", Female),
        sub("^(.*)-(.*)$", "F2 \\1x\\2x\\1x\\2", Female)), Female)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(CrossType = paste(Female, Male, sep = "x"))

##Summarize data for each CoupleID (272 rows)
merged_data <- data |>
  dplyr::group_by(CoupleID, CrossType, Female, Male, Batch, Block, Year) |>
  dplyr::summarise(sum_eggcount_corr = sum(EggCountCorr),
                   sum_larvacount = sum(LarvaeCount))

## Compute hatch rate for each CoupleID
merged_data <- merged_data |>
  dplyr::mutate(hatchrate = sum_larvacount / sum_eggcount_corr) 

##Save file with data for each coupleID
write.table(x = merged_data, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "Hatch_rate_CoupleID_Batch89.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```


# Fit models to test genetic effects with betabinomial
## Check structure of zero inflation
```{r, eval=TRUE}

## Subset the data with a single type of cross (229 rows)
strains <- c("Par6", "Bal", "F1 Par6xBal", "F1 BalxPar6", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal", "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6")
crosstype <- paste0("Amx", strains)

dat_g <- data[data$CrossType%in%crosstype, ]


## Compute proportion of eggs that hatch into larvae
dat_g$prop <- dat_g$LarvaeCount / dat_g$EggCountCorr

## Levels of factor Crosstype
levels(as.factor(dat_g$CrossType))

## Variable for autosomal effect (Par6: 1, Bal: -1, F1/F2: 0)
dat_g$alpha1 <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$alpha1) <- c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 0,+1) # alphabetical order
dat_g$alpha1 <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_g$alpha1))

## Variable for dominance (Par6/Bal: 0, F1: +1, F2: 0.5)
dat_g$dominance <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$dominance) <- c(0, 1, 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0)
dat_g$dominance <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_g$dominance))

## Variable for X effect (Par6: -1, Bal: +1, F1: -1 (Par6 mother) or +1 (Bal mother), F2: 0)
dat_g$X <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$X) <- c(-1, -1, +1, 0, 0, +1)
dat_g$X <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_g$X))

## Variable for Y effect (Par6: +1, Bal: -1, F1: +1 (Par6 father) or -1 (Bal father), F2: +1 (Par6 grandfather) or -1 (Bal grandfather))
dat_g$Y <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
levels(dat_g$Y) <- c(-1, 1, -1, 1, -1, 1)
dat_g$Y <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_g$Y))

## Variable for cytoplasm (Par6 or Bal depending on the mother/grandmother) not used for the paper
#dat_g$cyto <- as.factor(dat_g$CrossType)
#levels(dat_g$cyto) <- c("Bal", "Bal", "Par6", "Bal",  "Par6", "Par6")

## Check the parameters for each type of cross
unique(dat_g[, c("CrossType", "alpha1", "dominance", "X", "Y")])

## 40 zeros out of 229 Petri dishes
## With 2–3 observations per couple, the data barely separate the random coupleID from the zero inflation (i.e. “this couple has a low mean” from “this couple had chance structural zeros”).
z <- with(dat_g, tapply(prop == 0, CoupleID,
                           function(v) paste0(sum(v), "/", length(v))))
table(z)

msat_betabin_nozi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ CrossType + (1 | CoupleID),
                            ziformula = ~0, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), data = dat_g)
summary(msat_betabin_nozi)

## Model with zero inflation
msat_betabin_zi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ CrossType + (1 | CoupleID),
                            ziformula = ~1, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), data = dat_g)
c(negLL = msat_betabin_zi$fit$objective, pdHess = msat_betabin_zi$sdr$pdHess)

msat_betabin_zi_CrossType <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ CrossType + (1 | CoupleID),
                            ziformula = ~1+CrossType, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), data = dat_g)

msat_bin_nozi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ CrossType + (1 | CoupleID),
                            ziformula = ~0, family = binomial(), data = dat_g)

msat_bin_zi <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ CrossType + (1 | CoupleID),
                            ziformula = ~1, family = binomial(), data = dat_g)

msat_bin_zi_CrossType <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ CrossType + (1 | CoupleID),
                            ziformula = ~1+CrossType, family = binomial(), data = dat_g)

MuMIn::AICc(msat_betabin_nozi, msat_betabin_zi, msat_betabin_zi_CrossType, msat_bin_nozi, msat_bin_zi, msat_bin_zi_CrossType) 

## Check convergence
m <- msat_betabin_zi
c(conv = m$fit$convergence, pdHess = m$sdr$pdHess)

## 8% of zeros comes from the zero inflation (the rest comes from the betabibomial)
plogis(glmmTMB::fixef(m)$zi)          
glmmTMB::VarCorr(m)

so <- DHARMa::simulateResiduals(m, n = 1000)
## Check that residuals are close to the diagonal
plot(so)

## No remaining zero inflation
DHARMa::testZeroInflation(so)

obs0 <- tapply(dat_g$prop == 0, dat_g$CrossType, sum)
sim0 <- apply(so$simulatedResponse == 0, 2,
             function(z) tapply(z, dat_g$CrossType, sum))
cbind(observed = obs0,
       expected = round(rowMeans(sim0), 1),
       lo95     = apply(sim0, 1, quantile, 0.025),
       hi95     = apply(sim0, 1, quantile, 0.975))

## Cl: A model with a single zero inflation across cross types seems OK
```

## Model selection
```{r, eval=TRUE}

## List all models
forms <- list(
  m0   = prop ~ 1,
  m1   = prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + X + Y,
  m2   = prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + X,
  m3   = prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + Y,
  m4   = prop ~ alpha1 + X + Y,
  m5   = prop ~ dominance + X + Y,
  m6   = prop ~ alpha1 + X,
  m7   = prop ~ alpha1 + Y,
  m8   = prop ~ X + Y,
  m9   = prop ~ alpha1 + dominance,
  m10  = prop ~ dominance + X,
  m11  = prop ~ dominance + Y,
  m12  = prop ~ alpha1,
  m13  = prop ~ dominance,
  msat = prop ~ CrossType
)

## Fit models
mods <- lapply(forms, function(f)
  glmmTMB::glmmTMB(update(f, cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ . + (1 | CoupleID)),
                   ziformula = ~1, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), data = dat_g))

## Only m0 and m11 have convergence issues
t(sapply(mods, function(m) c(negLL = m$fit$objective,
                             conv = m$fit$convergence, pdHess = m$sdr$pdHess)))

## Compare AICc
#MuMIn::model.sel(mods[names(mods) != "msat"])
MuMIn::model.sel(mods)

## Check lack of fit
anova(mods$m1, mods$msat)
## Cl: The four genetic effects describe the six cross-type means almost perfectly, so the genetic model is an adequate description of the six types of crosses.

aic <- as.data.frame (MuMIn::model.sel(mods))

write.csv(
  tibble::rownames_to_column(as.data.frame(aic), "model"),
  file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "AICc_genetic_effect_F1_F2_X_Y.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)



```

# Castle-Wright estimation
## Check that the variance is homogenous in parental and F1 crosses
```{r, eval=TRUE}
dat_g$vgroup4 <- factor(ifelse(grepl("F2", dat_g$CrossType), "F2",
                        ifelse(grepl("F1", dat_g$CrossType), "F1",
                               sub("Amx", "", dat_g$CrossType))))   # Bal, Par6, F1, F2

## Model with a different variance only for parents, F1s and F2s
m_var4 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ CrossType + diag(0 + vgroup4 | CoupleID), ziformula = ~1, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), data = dat_g)

glmmTMB::VarCorr(m_var4)            # between-male variance for Bal, Par6, F1, F2


## Variable to fit different variances for F2 vs. the other crosstypes
dat_g$vargroup <- as.factor(grepl("F2", dat_g$CrossType)*1)

## Model with a different variance only for F2s vs. the other crosstypes
m_var <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(
  cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr - LarvaeCount) ~ CrossType + diag(0 + vargroup | CoupleID),
  ziformula = ~1, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), data = dat_g)
summary(m_var)

## No significant differences between variances in the parents and F1 so we can estimate a sigle parameter
anova(m_var, m_var4)

## F2 variance is not significantly larger (but low power as only 29 F2 crosses)
anova(update(m_var, . ~ CrossType + (1 | CoupleID)), m_var)

```

## Compute estimates
```{r, eval=TRUE}

vc   <- glmmTMB::VarCorr(m_var)$cond$CoupleID
s2E  <- vc["vargroup0", "vargroup0"]          # between-male variance, non-F2 groups
s2F2 <- vc["vargroup1", "vargroup1"]          # between-male variance, F2
b    <- glmmTMB::fixef(m_var)$cond            # check names with names(b)
delta <- (b["(Intercept)"]) - (b["(Intercept)"] + b["CrossTypeAmxPar6"])   # Bal - Par6 (Bal = reference)

s2S <- s2F2 - s2E
n_e <- delta^2 / (8 * s2S)
c(s2E = s2E, s2F2 = s2F2, s2S = s2S, n_e = n_e)
```


## Plotting the F2 male random effects (BLUPS) against the Bal and F1 means
```{r, eval=TRUE}
## Order of the male genotypes on the plot
ord <- c("AmxBal", "AmxF1 Par6xBal", "AmxF1 BalxPar6",
         "AmxF2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal", "AmxF2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6", "AmxPar6")

# One row per male (couple)
males <- unique(dat_g[, c("CoupleID", "CrossType", "vargroup")])

# Model-based male hatch rate: cross-type mean + couple effect, excluding structural zeros
males$pred <- predict(m_var, newdata = males, type = "conditional", re.form = NULL)

# Raw male hatch rate (pooled over his dishes), for comparison
raw <- aggregate(cbind(LarvaeCount, EggCountCorr) ~ CoupleID, data = dat_g, FUN = sum)
males <- merge(males, raw, by = "CoupleID")
males$raw <- males$LarvaeCount / males$EggCountCorr

# Cross-type means with 95% CI (population level)
ct <- data.frame(CrossType = ord, CoupleID = NA,
                 vargroup = factor(as.integer(grepl("F2", ord))))
p  <- predict(m_var, newdata = ct, type = "link", re.form = NA, se.fit = TRUE)
ct$fit <- plogis(p$fit)
ct$lo  <- plogis(p$fit - 1.96 * p$se.fit)
ct$hi  <- plogis(p$fit + 1.96 * p$se.fit)

ref <- ct[ct$CrossType %in% c("AmxBal", "AmxPar6"), ]
ref$lab <- sub("Amx", "", ref$CrossType)
ref$ylab <- ref$fit + ifelse(ref$lab == "Bal", 0.13, 0)   # raise Bal label only
#ref$xlab  <- ifelse(ref$lab == "Bal", 0.6, 6.4)
#ref$hjust <- ifelse(ref$lab == "Bal", 0, 1)

males$CrossType <- factor(males$CrossType, levels = ord)
ct$CrossType    <- factor(ct$CrossType,    levels = ord)
males$Generation <- ifelse(grepl("F2", males$CrossType), "F2",
                    ifelse(grepl("F1", males$CrossType), "F1", "Parental"))

p <- ggplot(males, aes(x = CrossType, y = pred)) +
  geom_hline(data = ref, aes(yintercept = fit), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey40") +
  geom_jitter(aes(colour = Generation), width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2.2, alpha = 0.75) +
  geom_pointrange(data = ct, aes(y = fit, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                  position = position_nudge(x = 0.3), size = 0.4) +
  geom_label(data = ref, aes(x = 0.6, y = ylab, label = lab),
             hjust = 0, vjust = -0.3, size = 3.5, colour = "grey30",
             fill = "white", label.size = 0, label.padding = unit(0.1, "lines")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) sub("Amx", "", x)) +
  scale_y_continuous("Hatch rate excluding structural zeros", limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Parental = "grey50", F1 = "#1b9e77", F2 = "#d95f02")) +
  labs(x = "Male genotype", colour = NULL) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1), legend.position = "top")
#save bar plot
title_plot <- "BLUPS_Par6_Bal_F1_F2.png"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   p, base_height = 12/cm(1),
                   base_width = 10/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

## Simulations to check how environmental variation affect the position of F2 relative to the parents
```{r}
f2 <- males[grepl("F2", males$CrossType), ]
lp <- qlogis(f2$pred)

centres <- qlogis(c(
  Bal  = ct$fit[ct$CrossType == "AmxBal"],
  F1   = mean(ct$fit[grepl("F1", ct$CrossType)]),
  Par6 = ct$fit[ct$CrossType == "AmxPar6"]))

f2$class <- factor(names(centres)[apply(abs(outer(lp, centres, "-")), 1, which.min)],
                   levels = c("Bal", "F1", "Par6"))
obs <- table(f2$class)
obs

# 1:2:1 (one locus, incomplete dominance)
chisq.test(obs, p = c(1, 2, 1) / 4, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e4)
# Two equal loci, additive (extremes 1/16 each)
chisq.test(obs, p = c(1, 14, 1) / 16, simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e4)


mid <- mean(centres[c("Bal", "Par6")])
a   <- unname((centres["Bal"] - centres["Par6"]) / 2)
d   <- unname(centres["F1"] - mid)

sim_props <- function(nloci, sd_e = 0.46, n = 1e5) {
  x <- matrix(sample(c(-1, 0, 1), n * nloci, TRUE, c(0.25, 0.5, 0.25)), n)   # F2 genotypes per locus
  g <- mid + a * rowMeans(x) + d * rowMeans(x == 0)   # equal-effect loci, same dominance ratio
  y <- g + rnorm(n, 0, sd_e)
  cls <- factor(names(centres)[apply(abs(outer(y, centres, "-")), 1, which.min)],
                levels = names(centres))
  as.numeric(prop.table(table(cls)))
}

set.seed(1)
props <- sapply(1:4, sim_props)
colnames(props) <- paste(1:4, "loci"); rownames(props) <- names(centres)
round(props * sum(obs), 1)          # expected counts out of 30 under each hypothesis

sapply(1:4, function(k) chisq.test(obs, p = props[, k],
                                   simulate.p.value = TRUE, B = 1e4)$p.value)
```

# Prediction for the different types of crosses
## Fit saturated for Table S7 and Fig. 5
```{r}
library(rlang)

# Fit msat model for all the data in Batch8 and Batch9
msat <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ -1 + CrossType + (1 | CoupleID), ziformula = ~1, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), data = data, weights = EggCountCorr)
summary(msat)

#Estimation of hatch rate from binomial part of the model
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(msat)$cond)))

#Estimation of confidence intervals
## Refit model nsim=500 times
set.seed(123)
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(msat, FUN=function(fit) extract_model(fit, estimateCI = FALSE, estimate_hatche_rate=TRUE), nsim=500, .progress="txt")

##Confidence intervals estimation
confint_msat <- data.frame(bCI_tab(b=b1)) |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "CrossType")

## Export files for the Table S7
write.table(x = confint_msat, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confint_saturated_model_msat.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)

```

## Full model m1 for Table S7
```{r}
library(rlang)

# Fit m1 model for all the data in Batch8 and Batch9
m1 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + dominance + X + Y + (1 | CoupleID), ziformula = ~1, family = glmmTMB::betabinomial(), data = dat_g, weights = EggCountCorr)
summary(m1)


#Estimation of hatch rate from binomial part of the model
(p2 <- 1/(1+exp(-glmmTMB::fixef(m1)$cond)))

#Estimation of confidence intervals
## Refit model nsim=500 times
set.seed(123)
b1 <- lme4::bootMer(m1, FUN=extract_model_logit_scale, nsim=500, .progress="txt")

##Confidence intervals estimation
confint_full_model <- data.frame(bCI_tab(b=b1))

confint_full_model <- confint_full_model |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Effects")

## Export files for the table S7
write.table(x = confint_full_model, file=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confint_full_model_m1.csv"), sep=";", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat_p, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)

newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(-1, 0, 1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)

    )

## Figure 5 with hatch rate in F1 anf F2 of crosses Bal and Par6 lines
```

# Plot predicted hatch rate for different genetic models
## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with cytoplasmic effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

###Load the data 
merged_data_p <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CoupleID_test_cross.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

strains <- c("Par6", "Bal")
crosstype <- paste0("Amx", strains)
dat_p <- merged_data_p[merged_data_p$CrossType%in%crosstype, ]

#Define variable for autosomal effect (Par6: 1, Bal:-1)
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.factor(dat_p$CrossType)
levels(dat_p$alpha1) <- c(-1, +1) # alphabetical order
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_p$alpha1))

m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat_p, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m2)
glmmTMB::diagnose(m2)

newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(-1, 0, 1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)
newdata$prop_Bal <- (newdata$alpha1 + 1)/2
newdata$prop_Par6 <- 1-newdata$prop_Bal

## Add CrossType
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m2, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)

# Make database and add proportion of Bal and Par6 genes
## Read data
data <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "confint_saturated_model_msat.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

#Make column with CrossType
data <- data |>
dplyr::mutate(CrossType = sub(".*CrossType", "", Type))

data <- data |>
dplyr::distinct(CrossType, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Filter cross types only for test cross to have observed line means
observed <- data |>
dplyr:: filter (CrossType %in% c ("AmxBal","AmxPar6","AmxF1 Par6xBal","AmxF1 BalxPar6", "AmxF2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal","AmxF2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6"))

##Add Cross and Strain to the observed line means
observed <- observed |>
dplyr:: mutate (Cross=c(rep("P1", 1), rep("P2", 1), rep("F1", 1), rep("F2", 1), rep("F1", 1), rep("F2", 1))) |>
dplyr:: mutate (Strain= infstrain)
## Expected lines means
expected <- data.frame(Cross=c("P1", "P2", "F1", "F2"), prop_Bal =c(1, 0, 0.5, 0.5), expected_hatchrate = c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], mean(c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2])), mean(c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2]))))

dat <- dplyr::left_join(observed, expected, by="Cross") |>
  dplyr::mutate(Strain=factor(Strain, levels=c("Bal","Par6","F1 Par6xBal","F1 BalxPar6", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal","F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6")))

#Add predicted values for cytoplasmic effect
dat$cytopl <- dat$Estimate

cytopl_Par6 <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Par6") |> dplyr::pull(cytopl) |> dplyr::first()
cytopl_bal <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Bal") |> dplyr::pull(cytopl) |> dplyr::first()

dat <- dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    cytopl = dplyr::case_when(
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "^(F1|F2) Par6x") ~ cytopl_Par6,
    stringr::str_detect(Strain, "^(F1|F2) Balx") ~ cytopl_bal,
      TRUE ~ cytopl))

dat <- dat |>
dplyr::distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Add proportion of Par6 genes 
dat$prop_Par6 <- 1-dat$prop_Bal

#Change proportion of Par6 for the figure
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_Par6 = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" ~ 0.535,
      Strain == "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" ~ 0.535,
      TRUE ~ prop_Par6))

#Change strain names for F2
dat$Strain_label <- dplyr::recode(
  dat$Strain,
  "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)",
  "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)")

#Make columns for coordinates of labeles in the plot 
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.06,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.02,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ prop_Par6 - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ prop_Par6 - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.20,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ prop_Par6 + 0.20,
      TRUE ~ prop_Par6
    ),
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ cytopl + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ cytopl + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ cytopl - 0.07,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ cytopl - 0.07,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ cytopl + 0.08,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ cytopl + 0.08,
      TRUE ~ cytopl
    )
  )

## Predicted hatch rate for cytoplasmic effect

pBal1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = pred.cond), color = "black", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = cytopl, fill = Strain_label), size = 25, shape = 21, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = dat, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = Strain_label, color = Strain_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Par6" = "violet", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "#00B6EB", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" = "#53B400", "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" = "#A58AFF")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Par6" = "violet", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "#00B6EB", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" = "#53B400", "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" = "#A58AFF")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0",  "0.5", "1"), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5","1"), expand = c(0, 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of Par6 suppressor allele(s)", y = "Hatch rate in test cross", title = "Cytoplasmic effect") +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.1, xend = 1.03, y = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.6, "cm")), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.1, xend = -0.1, y = 0, yend = 1.03, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.6, "cm")), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.1, 1.03), ylim = c(0, 1.03), clip = "off") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 60, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)), plot.margin = margin(t = 40, r = 60, b = 40, l = 40), axis.text = element_text(size = 40, color = "black"), axis.title = element_text(size = 50, face = "bold", color = "black"), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 20)), axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20)), axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

pBal1_clean <- pBal1 + labs(x = " ", y = " ")
pBal2_clean <- pBal2 + labs(x = " ", y = " ")
pBal3_clean <- pBal3 + labs(x = " ", y = " ")

pBal1_clean <- pBal1 + labs(x = " ", y = " ") + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 40, 0, 80))

pBal2_clean <- pBal2 + labs(x = " ", y = " ") + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 40, 0, 80))

pBal3_clean <- pBal3 + labs(x = " ", y = " ") + theme(plot.margin = margin(0, 40, 0, 80))

top_core <- cowplot::plot_grid(pBal1_clean, pBal2_clean, pBal3_clean, nrow = 1, labels = c("A", "B", "C"), label_size = 60, label_fontface = "bold")

top_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_plot(top_core, x = 0, y = 0, width = 1, height = 1) + cowplot::draw_label("Hatch rate in test cross", x = 0.025, y = 0.55, angle = 90, size = 50, fontface = "bold", colour = "black") + cowplot::draw_label("Proportion of Par6 suppressor allele(s)", x = 0.53, y = 0.04, size = 50, fontface = "bold", colour = "black")

bottom_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(pBal, labels = "D", label_size = 60, label_fontface = "bold")

combined_plot <- cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_plot(cowplot::plot_grid(top_plot, bottom_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(30, 90)), x = 0.025, y = 0.02, width = 0.965, height = 0.965)
```

# Plot predicted embryo mortality for different genetic models
## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with cytoplasmic effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Prediction of mortality depending on the proportion of Bal genes for the line in the figure

##Fit m2 model for additive effect only with parental strains (Additive autosomal effect)
###Load the data 
merged_data_p <- tibble::as_tibble(read.table(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "CoupleID_test_cross.csv"), sep=";", header = TRUE))

strains <- c("Par6", "Bal")
crosstype <- paste0("Amx", strains)
dat_p <- merged_data_p[merged_data_p$CrossType%in%crosstype, ]

#Define variable for autosomal effect (Par6: 1, Bal:-1)
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.factor(dat_p$CrossType)
levels(dat_p$alpha1) <- c(-1, +1) # alphabetical order
dat_p$alpha1 <- as.numeric(as.character(dat_p$alpha1))

m2 <- glmmTMB::glmmTMB(prop ~ alpha1 + (1 | CoupleID) , data=dat_p, ziformula=~ -1+ CrossType , family=binomial, weight=sum_eggcount_corr)
summary(m2)
glmmTMB::diagnose(m2)

newdata <- expand.grid(alpha1 = c(-1, 0, 1), dominance = -1, sum_eggcount_corr=100)
newdata$prop_Bal <- (newdata$alpha1 + 1)/2

## Add CrossType
newdata$CrossType <- "AmxBal"
newdata$pred.cond <- predict(m2, type="conditional", re.form=NA, newdata=newdata)

#Mortality for the line in the figure

newdata$pred.mortality <- 1- newdata$pred.cond

#Add predicted values for cytoplasmic effect
dat$cytopl <- dat$Mortality

cytopl_Par6 <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Par6") |> dplyr::pull(cytopl) |> dplyr::first()
cytopl_bal <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Bal") |> dplyr::pull(cytopl) |> dplyr::first()

dat <- dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    cytopl = dplyr::case_when(
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "^(F1|F2) Par6x") ~ cytopl_Par6,
    stringr::str_detect(Strain, "^(F1|F2) Balx") ~ cytopl_bal,
      TRUE ~ cytopl))

dat <- dat |>
dplyr::distinct(Strain, .keep_all = TRUE)

#Change proportion of Bal for the figure
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_Bal = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" ~ 0.535,
      Strain == "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" ~ 0.535,
      TRUE ~ prop_Bal
    )
  )

#Make columns for coordinates of labeles in the plot 
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ prop_Bal + 0.06,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ prop_Bal + 0.02,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ prop_Bal - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ prop_Bal - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ prop_Bal + 0.20,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ prop_Bal + 0.20,
      TRUE ~ prop_Bal
    ),
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ cytopl + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ cytopl + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ cytopl - 0.07,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ cytopl - 0.07,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ cytopl + 0.08,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ cytopl + 0.08,
      TRUE ~ cytopl
    )
  )

## Predicted embryo mortality for cytoplasmic effect

pBal1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = pred.mortality), color = "black", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = cytopl, fill = Strain), size = 25, shape = 21, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = dat, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = Strain_label, color = Strain), size = 10, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Par6" = "#A58AFF", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "royalblue", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "#53B400", "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "violet")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Par6" = "#A58AFF", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "royalblue", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "#53B400", "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "violet")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0",  "0.5", "1"), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5","1"), expand = c(0, 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of Bal genes", y = "Embryo mortality in test cross", title = "Cytoplasmic effect") +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.1, xend = 1.03, y = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.6, "cm")), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.1, xend = -0.1, y = 0, yend = 1.03, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.6, "cm")), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.1, 1.03), ylim = c(0, 1.03), clip = "off") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 60, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)), plot.margin = margin(t = 40, r = 60, b = 40, l = 40), axis.text = element_text(size = 40, color = "black"), axis.title = element_text(size = 50, face = "bold", color = "black"), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 20)), axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20)), axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE}
#Add predicted values for dominance effect
dat$dominance <- dat$Mortality

par6 <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(Strain == "Par6") |>
  dplyr::pull(dominance) |>
  dplyr::first()

bal <- dat |>
  dplyr::filter(Strain == "Bal") |>
  dplyr::pull(dominance) |>
  dplyr::first()

dom_F2 <- par6 + (bal - par6) * 0.25

    dominance = dplyr::case_when(
```

## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with X effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

#Add predicted values for X-linked effect
dat$X <- dat$Mortality

X_F1_P <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Par6") |> dplyr::pull(X) |> dplyr::first()
X_F1_B <- dat |> dplyr::filter(Strain == "Bal") |> dplyr::pull(X) |> dplyr::first()
X_F2 <- newdata |> dplyr::filter(alpha1 == "0") |> dplyr::pull(pred.mortality) |> dplyr::first()

dat <- dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    X = dplyr::case_when(
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "F1 Par6") ~ X_F1_P,
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "F1 Bal") ~ X_F1_B,
    stringr::str_detect(Strain, "F2 ") ~ X_F2,
      TRUE ~ X))

#Change proportion of Bal for the figure
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    prop_Bal = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ 0.5,
      Strain == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ 0.5,
      Strain == "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" ~ 0.460,
      Strain == "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" ~ 0.535,
      TRUE ~ prop_Bal
    )
  )

#Make columns for coordinates of labeles in the plot 
dat <- dat |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    label_x = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ prop_Bal + 0.06,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ prop_Bal + 0.02,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ prop_Bal + 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ prop_Bal - 0.12,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ prop_Bal - 0.23,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ prop_Bal + 0.23,
      TRUE ~ prop_Bal
    ),
    label_y = dplyr::case_when(
      Strain_label == "Par6" ~ X + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "Bal" ~ X + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "F1 BalxPar6" ~ X + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "F1 Par6xBal" ~ X - 0.1,
      Strain_label == "F2 (Par6xBal)x(Par6xBal)" ~ X + 0.1,
      Strain_label == "F2 (BalxPar6)x(BalxPar6)" ~ X - 0.1,
      TRUE ~ X
    )
  )

## Predicted embryo mortality for X-linked effect

pBal3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = pred.mortality), color = "black", alpha = 0.6, linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_point(data = dat, aes(x = prop_Bal, y = X, fill = Strain), size = 25, shape = 21, alpha = 0.6, color = "black", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_text(data = dat, aes(x = label_x, y = label_y, label = Strain_label, color = Strain), size = 10, fontface = "bold", show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Par6" = "#A58AFF", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "royalblue", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "#53B400", "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "violet")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Par6" = "#A58AFF", "Bal" = "#F8766D", "F1 Par6xBal" = "royalblue", "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094", "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "#53B400", "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "violet")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0",  "0.5", "1"), expand = c(0.02, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = c(0, 0.5, 1), labels = c("0", "0.5","1"), expand = c(0, 0.02)) +
  labs(x = "Proportion of Bal genes", y = "Embryo mortality in test cross", title = "X-linked effect") +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.1, xend = 1.03, y = 0, yend = 0, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.6, "cm")), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  annotate("segment", x = -0.1, xend = -0.1, y = 0, yend = 1.03, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.6, "cm")), linewidth = 1.2, color = "black") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.1, 1.03), ylim = c(0, 1.03), clip = "off") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 60, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)), plot.margin = margin(t = 40, r = 60, b = 40, l = 40), axis.text = element_text(size = 40, color = "black"), axis.title = element_text(size = 50, face = "bold", color = "black"), axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 20)), axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 20)), axis.line = element_blank(), axis.ticks = element_blank(), legend.position = "none")

pBal3
```

## Plot for predicted F1 and F2 with autosomal additive effect Par6 / Bal
```{r, eval=FALSE}

## Observed line means
dat <- data.frame(Strain= c(rep("Par6", 1), rep("Bal", 1), rep("F1 Par6xBal", 1), rep("F1 BalxPar6", 1), rep("F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal", 1), rep("F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6", 1)), Cross=c(rep("P1", 1), rep("P2", 1), rep("F1", 2), rep("F2", 2)), prop_Par6 =c(1, 0, 0.495, 0.505,0.49, 0.51), observed_hatch_rate = c(data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Par6"][2], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="Bal"][2],
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F1 Par6xBal")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1 Par6xBal"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1 Par6xBal"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F1 BalxPar6")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1 BalxPar6"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F1 BalxPar6"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal"][2]),
ifelse(sum(data$infstrain=="F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6")==1, data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6"], data$Estimate[data$infstrain=="F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6"][2])))

#Add predicted values for autosomal additive effect
dat$ad <- dat$observed_hatch_rate

adit <- newdata |> dplyr::filter(alpha1 == "0") |> dplyr::pull(pred.cond) |> dplyr::first()


dat <- dat |> dplyr::mutate(
    ad = dplyr::case_when(
     stringr::str_detect(Strain, "F") ~ adit,
     TRUE ~ ad))


## Predicted hatch rate for autosomal additive effect

pBal <- dat %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=prop_Par6, y=ad, color=Strain))  + 
  #geom_jitter(width = 0.005, size=5, height = 0) +
  geom_point(size=20, alpha = 0.7) +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
  aes(label = Strain),
  size = 20,
  nudge_y = 0.03,
  segment.color = NA,
  show.legend = FALSE
) + 
  geom_line(data = newdata, aes(x = prop_Par6, y = pred.cond, color="black")) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Par6" = "violet",
      "Bal" = "#F8766D",
      "F1 Par6xBal" = "#00B6EB",
      "F1 BalxPar6" = "#00C094",
      "F2 Par6xBalxPar6xBal" = "#53B400",
      "F2 BalxPar6xBalxPar6" = "#A58AFF"))+
  labs(x = "Proportion of Par6 genes", y = "Hatch rate in cross W- X W+ ") +   ggtitle("Predicted hatch rate in CI cross for autosomal additive effect") +
#  xlim(0, 1) +
#  ylim(0, 1) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"), axis.text = element_text(size = 40),
axis.title=element_text(size=40, face="bold"), legend.position="none")

pBal

#save bar plot
title_plot <- "Hatch_rate_F1_F2_Par6_Bal_ad.pdf"
cowplot::save_plot(file = here::here("plots", title_plot),
                   pBal, base_height = 40/cm(1),
                   base_width = 50/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```
